subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Peristaltic Pumps: Squeezing the Tube
description: One-minute skill: Peristaltic Pumps: Squeezing the Tube.

hook.text: Your gut moves food by squeezing in waves. A peristaltic pump copies that.

buildup.text: Rollers compress a flexible tube, pushing fluid forward as they rotate.

discovery.text: Fluid only touches the tube — never the pump. Contamination is impossible.

twist.text: The tube wears out and needs replacing, but it's the only wearing part.

climax.text: Blood transfusions, drug dosing, and food processing rely on these pumps.

punchline.text: Squeeze a tube and the fluid has no choice but to move.

quiz.question: Why are peristaltic pumps ideal for medical use?
options: They can pump at extremely high pressures
Fluid never contacts the pump — only the disposable tube
They are quieter than other pump types
